title: FluxMarket
description: An advanced dynamic market and borsa order system featuring shopping carts and unique counter-offer mechanics.
body:
# 🛒 FluxMarket - Advanced Dynamic Market & Borsa Order System

**FluxMarket** is a next-generation economy plugin for Minecraft servers that goes far beyond standard static shops. It introduces a fully dynamic server-wide borsa (order block) ecosystem and an intuitive shopping cart experience, allowing players to interact, trade, and bargain like never before.

---

## ✨ Core Features

* **📦 Advanced Borsa & Order System:** Players can create buy orders for specific items and quantities at their own custom prices. Other players can browse the global order board and fulfill these demands instantly.
* **🤝 Unique Counter-Offer Mechanic:** Bargaining made easy! Players can right-click any active global order to send a custom **Counter Offer** back to the buyer via chat. 
* **🛒 Shopping Cart Ecosystem:** Instead of purchasing items one by one, players can add multiple items to their cart and check out everything at once to save time.
* **🗂️ Dynamic Category Management:** Easily configure unlimited categories, custom display icons, and inventory slots directly through `categories.yml`.
* **👤 Profile & History Panel:** Players can track their spending history, view past transactions, and manage incoming counter-offers through a dedicated personal GUI.
* **🌍 Full Multi-Language Support:** The plugin comes with built-in localization files (`tr` and `en`). Every single message, menu title, and button description can be fully customized.

---

## 🛠️ Commands & Permissions

### Player Commands
* `/market` - Opens the main dynamic market interface. *(No permission required)*

### Admin Commands
> **Required Permission:** `fluxmarket.admin` or **OP**

* `/market additem <Category> <Item_Unique_Key> <Slot> <Buy_Price> <Sell_Price>` - Adds an item to the market configuration on the fly.
* `/market createcategory <Category_Key> <Slot> <Material> <Display_Name>` - Creates a brand new GUI category safely.
* `/market reload` - Reloads all configuration and language files instantly without restarting the server.

---

## ⚙️ Dependencies

To ensure smooth financial transactions, FluxMarket requires the following plugin installed on your server:
* **Vault** (along with any compatible economy provider, e.g., EssentialsX, EcoBits, etc.)
